title: Northgate Credit Card Spend Reduction on Northgate Optical Accidental Replacements
content:
Members who use their Northgate credit card for Northgate purchases receive a reduction of the Northgate Optical accidental replacement charge. The spend is read from the member's Northgate Credit Cards reward entries.

**Northgate card spend.** The member's Northgate card spend is the Northgate qualifying spend on which the member's Northgate credit card earned card rewards, in statement entries dated less than twelve whole months before the day the replacement is authorized. Only card reward entries in the Northgate purchases earning category are read, and the figure taken is the qualifying spend each entry was computed on.

**Reduction.** Where that Northgate card spend is at least 2000.00, the accidental replacement charge is reduced by 10 percent, and where it is at least 750.00 but less than 2000.00, it is reduced by 5 percent. A Northgate card spend below 750.00 brings no card spend reduction.

| Northgate card spend over the last twelve months (USD) | Card spend reduction |
|---|---|
| below 750.00 | none |
| 750.00 up to but not including 2000.00 | 5 percent |
| 2000.00 or more | 10 percent |

## Examples (hypothetical cardholders)

| Monthly reward entries in the period (Northgate purchases qualifying spend) | Total | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| twelve entries of 170.00 | 2040.00 | 10 percent |
| ten entries of 199.99 | 1999.90 | 5 percent |
| three entries of 250.00 | 750.00 | 5 percent |
| entries in other earning categories only | 0.00 | none |

A statement entry dated twelve whole months or more before the day of authorization is outside the period.
